curated.note: Hand-curated against commit e031523. Not model-produced; verified_by_agent stays false.

module_responsibilities: Single-file Vue SFC front-end for the review knowledge base: loads categories/sources, opens revisions and fragments, runs search and relation tracing.
Boot detects /api/review/health and switches the app into review mode; it owns no business state.
boundaries: Pure presentation: every read goes through review-api.ts to the loopback review API.
Never talks to Lark, the personal-assistant runtime or external services.

key_flows.name: boot
key_flows.description: boot() refreshes health, loads categories and sources on mount.

key_flows.name: search-trace
key_flows.description: runSearch queries the API; runTrace follows a fragment's relation graph.

risks_and_limits: The component symbol itself is not modeled by the code-understanding snapshot (component kind); only <script setup> functions are cited.
No automated browser check in this slice; UI rendering is not asserted.
unknowns: Real layout, empty states and relation-trace UX are not verified here.

claims.text: boot() initializes health, categories and sources on mount
openRevision loads a revision's parts and selected fragment detail

evidence.text: Review app binds loopback only, starts no Lark/worker/notifications and owns no business state.
